title: 36 Hours in New York City
abstract: In the last year, the city has opened a hot new park and Lincoln Center celebrated its 50th anniversary with a major face-lift.

title: 36 Hours in Whistler, British Columbia
abstract: The valley is home to something else that makes it particularly welcoming to Olympic athletes: a global citizenry, ranging from old-school hippies to French-babbling Québécois.

title: 36 Hours in Mexico City
abstract: Eager to attract people again, luxury hotels are slashing room rates and restaurants are opening in chic neighborhoods.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: This city draws food lovers, design buffs and party people with its riotous night life and fashion-forward styling.
